candidates.visible_reason: On the lower tie below the lower tie plate, the wood surface shows deep longitudinal cracks. A wide dark split runs down the middle of the tie and widens toward the bottom edge. The grain looks rough and weathered, with raised fibers.
candidates.uncertainty: Medium. The crack is clearly visible, but the photo cannot show how deep it goes or whether the tie is structurally affected. Shadow inside the split may make it look darker or deeper than it is.
alternatives: Normal surface checking from seasoning and weathering of wood
Shadow exaggerating the apparent depth of the split
Debris or soil packed in the crack

candidates.uncertainty: Medium to high. The cracks look like surface checks, and the photo gives no clear sign of how severe they are.
alternatives: Normal weathering checks in the wood

alternatives: Unused spike holes or an alternate fastening design
